subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the passage in no more than 90 to 100 words.
guide_solution: Rebel poet, our national poet Kazi Nazrul Islam was born in 1306 BS in Burdwan. At the age of eleven, he showed his poetic genius. At the age of nineteen, he joined the Army. Returning from the battle field, he started to write poem. His famous poem 'Bidrohi' stirred the whole nation. In 1971 Bangladesh became independent and he was brought him here from Calcutta and was declared our national poet. He died in 1976 and was buried in the compound of Dhaka University Mosque.
